spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin when trend scores are above 7 and price closes at a 10-day high, exiting when trend score falls below 5.
spec.untestable_reason: Entry and exit depend on proprietary Bitcoin Trend Score which cannot be expressed with available indicators.

claimed.other: average gain of 1436.28% per win, while losses averaged -18.78%; ten buy signals

assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Bitcoin Trend Score and Bitcoin Relative Trend Score thresholds (>7 for entry, <5 for exit) - proprietary indicators with no definition in schema, form the heart of the strategy.

Timeframe 1d taken from page chart timeframe.
Entry requires all three conditions simultaneously; exit acts independently per claim text, but not compiled because core is untestable.
